minutes.headline: Committee approved the fall two sports season, shared turf use with other schools, and reduced fees for two sports.
minutes.summary: The athletic director presented the fall two season plan (football, indoor track, cheer, unified basketball) with COVID protocols, and the committee voted to approve it and to allow other schools to use the turf. It also approved reduced user fees for indoor track and unified basketball. The committee then set the chair as paper warrant signatory with a succession order, and heard one public comment raising concerns about scheduling, porta-potties and injuries.

public_comment.topic: Concerns about other football teams using the turf while track practices, scheduling and numbers, porta-potty cleaning, and injuries in cold conditions; sad no indoor track meets.

votes.motion: Accept the athletic director's proposal to play the fall two season and use facilities for other schools
Accept the reduced fee for indoor track and unified basketball as outlined
Appoint chair as primary warrant signatory, vice chair secondary, secretary tertiary (amended to positions), others signing electronically

budget_items.what_was_said: Porta toilets will be rented for football games and the cost shared among participating schools.

budget_items.topic: User fee reduction indoor track and unified basketball
budget_items.what_was_said: Athletic director asked for reduced user fees because no competitions are scheduled; money still goes to equipment and uniforms.
Indoor track and unified basketball proposed at flat per-athlete fees; football fee unchanged with multi-sport discount.

budget_items.topic: Uniforms for indoor track and cheer
budget_items.what_was_said: New uniforms were bought early; part of user fees will offset the cost.
Certificates of insurance received from visiting schools using the turf, forwarded to central office.
The district is looking into purchasing DocuSign for warrant signatures.

decisions.decision: Warrant process continues: all members review and sign electronically, chair signs the paper copy for town hall; district to pursue DocuSign.

what_happened.line: The School Committee voted 5-0 to approve the athletic director's plan to play the fall two season and to let other schools use the turf.
The committee voted 5-0 to accept reduced user fees for indoor track and unified basketball, because no competitions are scheduled.
The committee voted 5-0 to name the chair as primary warrant signatory, then vice chair and secretary in order, with other members signing electronically.
The district is looking into buying DocuSign for warrant signatures; until then the chair signs the paper copy for town hall.
One public comment raised concerns about turf scheduling, porta-potty cleaning and injuries in cold conditions.

why_it_matters: Families of indoor track and unified basketball athletes pay lower user fees this season, and the turf will be shared with visiting schools, with porta-toilet rental costs split among participating schools.
A possible DocuSign purchase would be a small new district cost, and the signatory order sets who approves the bills paid each week.
